name: A Friend in Need
label: Quest
description: Iverron lies bitten and in danger in Shadowglen. The young night elf calls for Dirania Silvershine, whose help may save him from Githyiss the Vile's venom.

clips.title: The story
paras: Iverron lies bitten and in danger in Shadowglen. The young night elf calls for Dirania Silvershine, whose help may save him from Githyiss the Vile's venom.

Iverron lies weakened after a bite from Githyiss the Vile. He ignored warnings and went too near the webwood caverns, where the vicious spider struck. Dizziness and failing strength leave him unable to reach safety alone.

Iverron sends passersby toward Aldrassil's central tree to find Dirania Silvershine. She looks out for him and knows the dangers of Shadowglen. His life may depend on her preparing an antidote before the venom proves fatal.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ughhh... I was bitten very badly by a spider named Githyiss the Vile while exploring the spider cave very close to here. I am sure I have been seriously poisoned; you must help me.
Please tell Dirania Silvershine. She will be able to help me.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh dear; I was wondering why I hadn't seen Iverron yet today. And I've always warned him about those spiders...
